card.name: Currency sign before a price
card.fires_on: The dollar or pound sign (or the spot just before the amount) right after a verb or phrase like 'cost', 'earned', 'averaged', 'was', in general web text about prices and wages. It expects a number to come next.

modes.label: Dollar sign before amount
modes.description: A $ or £ symbol directly before a price, wage or sum, often in historical or economic passages.

modes.label: Slot before a small price
modes.description: The space or linking word just before an amount where the currency is implied or spelled out.
